title: Chapter 6978: Think Too Highly

Chapter 6978: Think Too Highly

Chapter 6978: Think Too Highly

Tribulation Daoist and the others became slack-jawed. Li Qiye’s defeat of Godfiend Monarch was frightening enough. Now, he had just refined five overlords into ore mines without doing anything.

This meant he could destroy worlds with a single thought - a realm they couldn’t possibly imagine.

Tile Immortal itself was shocked by the unprecedented display of might. An immortal such as himself couldn’t have done so, not even a golden or a primordial one.

Could this ordinary mortal be a celestial immortal? This couldn’t possibly be true.

“Now do you want to talk?” Li Qiye smiled.

Tile somehow felt fear again. The instinct couldn’t be suppressed.

“What do you want?” Tile said; its color turned paler.

“You tell me.” Li Qiye smiled harmlessly.

“Don’t come over here.” Tile staggered backward.

“Alright, it’s time to speak. I might be merciful if you tell me everything you know.” Li Qiye smiled.

Tile thought that his smile was scarier than a wolf’s visage while stalking a sheep.

“I don’t know anything.” Tile decided to run - something it had never done before. Reputation and prestige mattered not after staring at Li Qiye face-to-face.

Alas, Li Qiye always appeared in front of it regardless of its speed and change of direction. He latched onto it like a shadow.

“Who-who are you?” It stammered.

“A passerby.” Li Qiye gave the usual answer.

“Yo-you best let me go.” It tried to be courageous.

“And if I don’t?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Don’t you want to save this world? I will destroy it if you don’t let me go.” It threatened.

“Do you think this threat can work against me?” Li Qiye said.

“Try it then, don’t regret after the fact.” It said.

“Haven’t heard this in a long time. Don’t worry, this world has nothing to do with me, I’m no savior.” Li Qiye said.

“W-what?” It didn’t expect this answer.

“But the crux of the issue is your lack of awareness. You think too highly of yourself. How are you going to destroy anything in my presence?” Li Qiye said.

“Try then...” It spoke without confidence.

“I just wanted to talk but if you are courting death, I’ll just extract your memories. Let’s see what you can do to destroy this world first.” Li Qiye said.

“Don’t come over here!” It shouted.
